cases.brief: Design a passive mounting bracket for a shelf. Specify its geometry and manufacturing constraints. No electronics or moving parts are included.
Design a motorized mechanical assembly, including its mounting, motion constraints and wiring. Supply and load specifications still need to be gathered.

Design a passive organ-on-chip body with a fluid network and a biological experiment. Include the chip geometry, fluid channels, biological compartments and measurements. External pumping and all electrical hardware are outside scope.
Design an organ-on-chip system including the chip body, fluid channels, biological experiment, and electrically controlled pumping hardware with its wiring and mechanical mounts.

Design only a passive mount for an existing electric motor. Include mounting geometry and mechanical loads. The motor, its internal mechanism, its wiring and controller are existing equipment outside this design scope.
Design only the electrical connections and power rails between an existing 5 V supply, controller and sensor. Exclude enclosure geometry, mechanical mounting and physical cable routing.

Design only a gravity-fed water network: reservoir connections, tubing topology and flow constraints. The supporting structure is fixed and outside scope. There are no electric pumps or biological experiments.
Build an inventory dashboard for purchased equipment. This is software only; do not design, simulate or modify any physical, electrical, fluidic or biological system.
